wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: an escaping path may be refused with any client error; the contract only requires the outside file to stay unread. A crash on a legitimate in-directory reference is caught by the functional suite.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: every sink reads exactly the file the document names; there is no neighbouring or proxy resource to authorise instead.
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the protected operation is a plain file read with no role, peer or direction dimension.
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the flaw is a read; the project has no write counterpart to this sink in scope.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the reference is a plain filesystem path, not a parsed identity whose malformed spelling could make a guard see nothing.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: containment is path-based; there is no external authority that could return no secret/role and make the guard fail open.
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: each sink is guarded on its own resolved path and no shared-helper fix changes a sibling API's stated behaviour; pass-alt.patch shows an independent shared-helper design still scoring 1.0.
